_meta.purpose: Rules to normalize and compare software version strings so existing version-comparison logic is more robust. ENRICHMENT/SUPPORT ONLY: this NEVER decides that a target is vulnerable - it only cleans a version string a scanner already extracted, and records vendor display names. No finding is created and no severity is assigned here.

semver_coercion.comment: Coerce loose dotted versions to a comparable (major, minor, patch) tuple. Missing components default to 0. Non-numeric trailing components are dropped, not guessed.

separator_normalization.comment: Treat these as equivalent component separators before splitting into a version tuple.

vendor_display_names.comment: Canonical display name for a normalized vendor token. Display/labelling ONLY - not used for vulnerability matching (which is exact-CVE-ID via the scanners).

epoch_strip.comment: Distro package epoch prefix like '2:1.4.6' -> drop the leading 'N:' epoch before parsing.
